label: resonance region fitted by INCOGNITA to raw EXFOR transmission data (own Reich-Moore fit); not a library file

segments.what: Reich-Moore fit to 2 GELINA transmission sets (EXFOR 23325005, 23325006; 150-1000 eV): R' 7.82 +- 0.36 fm, bound levels at -6.43 keV and -0.73 keV, one resonance at 230.3 eV, s-wave levels at 2.5-4.5 keV for the tails

exp.note: Birge-inflated weighted mean of direct thermal measurements (20561004, 20789018, 23488019); a trained datum of the fit

ri.note: integral of capture/E from 0.5 eV over the whole 0 K PENDF: this file below 1 keV, ENDF/B-VIII.1 carrier above. Card J2 (measured RI, EXFOR 12866033 etc.): ours 2.09 b vs 2.15-2.36 b measured; passed only on the no-harm clause.

join.note: energy-averaged 800-1200 eV, since a pointwise value at 1 keV falls between resonances

sources: thermal capture and coherent scattering length (EXFOR 11783005) trained; R' prior from EXFOR 20688006
reconstruction: NJOY2016 RECONR 0 K (RESINTEG arm Cu65_S2X, desktop ~/resinteg/arms/Cu65_S2X; tape sha256 in its status.json)
above 1 keV the carrier file is ENDF/B-VIII.1 (not drawn here; it enters only the 1000-1200 eV half of the join average and the RI tail)
caveat: PROVISIONAL own fit. The held-out transmission check (ORELA, EXFOR 10725015) could not be calibrated (ENDF/B-VIII.1 itself scores chi2/pt 6.95 there); ours 4.86, but in 10-100 eV ours is worse (4.79 vs 2.40) and reads 11-15 % high (C/E 1.11-1.15 vs 0.97-1.02). Elastic below 1 keV is about 10 % high, most likely because the one trained coherent scattering length (EXFOR 11783005, 11.09 fm) pulls thermal elastic to 15.8 b. Resonance integral passes only on the no-harm clause (z 3.76 vs ENDF/B-VIII.1 6.40). The OpenMC gate v3 (advisory) fails. in the hybrid library lib_res_v0 (RESINTEG, 2026-10-27) as PROVISIONAL. The Explorer's smooth 1 keV capture value (0.685 b, engine average) is 179 times this file's 800-1200 eV average (0.0038 b, ENDF/B-VIII.1 carrier above 1 keV), so the step at 1 keV comes from the engine curve, not from this file.
caveat_short: provisional own fit; elastic ~10 % high below 1 keV
